template.description: Timeline id the rows patch; default `main`. A single generated clip is a timeline holding that one clip.

additionalProperties.description: `<clipId>.props.<dot.path>` (a value written at that path of an adapter clip's props) or `<clipId>.asset` (a media clip's asset).

slots.description: Slot name → what it sets: `<clipId>.props.<dot.path>` or `<clipId>.asset`.

id.description: Row id, used as the output file name: lowercase letters, digits and `-`, up to 64, e.g. `es` or `product-12`.

items.description: `id` plus one value per slot it sets, e.g. `{ "id": "es", "title": "Hola", "voice": "assets/vo-es.wav" }`.

rows.description: One render per row (times each format), in order.

formats.description: Formats of the project each row renders in (`format.list`); default the primary only.

items.description: Format id, e.g. `9x16` or `web-1600x900`: lowercase letters, digits and `-`, up to 40; not png, jpg, jpeg or webp.

preset.description: Export preset id; default the project's `export.defaultPreset`, else the built-in default.
